kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-parameter --name workspace.para --properties Value=value123 EnvType=Prod --type PlainConstant --project-id 1000 --owner 123456789 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateParameter

parameters.help_en: The parameter name. It must be unique within the workspace, be prefixed with `workspace.`, and not exceed 255 characters. The part of the name after the prefix must start with a letter and can contain only letters, digits, and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh: 参数名称，工作空间下唯一。需要"workspace."开头。后续内容以字母开头，且只能包含字母下划线和数字，Name总长度不超过255
parameters.name: name

fields.help_en:
The environment.

`Prod`: production environment

`Dev`: development environment
fields.help_zh:
项目环境。
Prod：生产
Dev：开发
fields.name: env_type

fields.help_en: The value of the parameter. The value can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and the following special characters: /, :, ., [, ], ,, \, ', ", _, =, ?, space, carriage return, line feed, +, -, *, %, &, @, !, $, #, {, and }
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The value configurations for the parameter. A configuration for the production environment is required. If you provide duplicate configurations for an environment, only the first one is used
parameters.help_zh: 参数值配置，生产环境必填。如果数组中出现了重复的环境配置，则后出现的配置不生效
parameters.name: properties

parameters.help_en:
The type of the parameter.

`PlainConstant`: plaintext constant.

`SecretConstant`: secret constant.

`Variable`: variable
parameters.help_zh:
类型。
PlainConstant 常量（明文）
SecretConstant  常量（密文）
Variable  变量
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. This parameter is required when `Scope` is set to `Project`
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The account ID of the owner
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en: The scope of the parameter. The default value is `Project`. No other values are currently supported
parameters.help_zh: 参数使用范围。默认Project，暂不可选择其他类型
parameters.name: scope
